essence: The best practitioner should worship the eight Bhairavas with fragrance, flowers, and similar offerings.
The eight worshippable Bhairavas are identified in one verse beginning with Asitāṅga.
One should satisfy the ten directional guardians beginning with Indra.
Having become composed and attentive, one should give the offering to the goddess.
The prescribed items are traditionally remembered as excellent.
